He led by five strokes standing on the 10th tee, then proceeded to bogey the 10th and 11th holes before putting two balls in the water on 12 to make a quadruple bogey 7. Meanwhile, Danny Willett sailed past both Spieth and LSU’s Smylie Kaufman – playing in the final group with Spieth but on his way to an 81 – with a bogey-free 67. Willett finished at 5-under par, beating Spieth and fellow Englishman Lee Westwood by three. Willett joined three-time champion Nick Faldo as the only players from England to ever capture the green jacket.
